metaDescription: Six compact washers at or below the $300 cap, from twin tubs to one fully automatic, compared on wash capacity, spin power and the chores each one demands.
expertTake: The Auertech 28 lb twin tub is the pick for most buyers because its 18 lb wash tub and 1300 rpm spin do the most real work under the cap. The SUPER DEAL 13 lb is the value choice for one or two people. Anyone who wants a machine that washes, rinses and spins without manual steps should stretch to the ROVSUN 25 lb at the top of the cap, the one fully automatic option here.
introParagraphs: At this price the compact washer market is dominated by twin tubs, simple machines with one tub for washing and another for spinning dry. They are mechanically honest and cheap to run, but they ask you to move wet laundry between tubs and to stand by for timers.

That makes the buying question practical rather than technical. How much laundry do you wash, how much hand work will you accept, and how will you drain the machine? Prices move, and the $300 cap reflects listing prices at the time this guide was updated, so check the live listing before you buy.

products.name: Auertech 28 lb twin tub washer with drain pump 1300 rpm
products.description:
The Auertech stands out under the cap because its stated numbers are the biggest: an 18 lb wash tub inside a 28 lb total rating, a 1300 rpm spin motor and a drain pump that lets you move wastewater up and out. Two separate tubs mean the spin tub can extract water from one load while the wash tub works on the next, which roughly doubles throughput compared with a one-drum machine.

The cost is manual labor. You lift soaked clothes from the wash tub to the spin basket by hand, and the spin basket holds noticeably less than the wash tub, so a full wash load often needs two spins. Against the SUPER DEAL 13 lb it holds well over a third more.

Ownership is mostly about lint and balance. Clear the lint filter after each wash, spread clothes evenly in the spin basket so the cabinet does not walk and let both tubs dry with the lids open between uses. The drain pump needs a clear hose, so check for kinks at the start of a cycle. A practical routine is to run the wash, move the clothes, start the spin and refill the wash tub with the next load's water while the spin runs, which is where the twin tub earns its keep. Keep a dry towel on the floor under the drain hose for the first few loads until you know how the water leaves the machine.
products.bestFor: Households that wash larger loads and will transfer laundry by hand.
pros: Largest stated capacity under the cap
Wash and spin tubs run together
cons: Spin tub holds fewer pounds than the wash tub
Lightweight cabinet can walk when unbalanced

products.name: SUPER DEAL 13 lb compact twin tub washer with spin cycle
products.description:
SUPER DEAL's 13 lb twin tub has a 15 minute wash timer, a 5 minute spin timer and a 1300 rpm motor. Those timers define how you use it: set the wash, move the clothes, set the spin, and repeat. The simple controls are the appeal, since there are no menus and few parts to break.

Its capacity is the limit. At 13 lb it suits one or two people, and bulky items like towels will need split loads. Compared with the Auertech it is smaller and lighter, and it saves money and counter space in return.

For ownership, the thing to watch is the lid switch on the spin tub, which stops the motor when the lid lifts. Keep the lid latched during spin, balance the load and wipe the tubs after each use so soap film does not build. With a tub this small, use a little less detergent than the label suggests for a full-size washer, since suds that cannot rinse away are the usual reason clothes feel stiff. Store the hose coiled loosely and keep the power cord clear of the wet area.
products.bestFor: Singles and couples who want the simplest and cheapest working machine.
pros: Simple knob timers with no menus
13 lb handles several outfits and a few towels
cons: Small for bedding and bulky items
Short wash timer needs resetting for heavy soil

products.name: INTERGREAT 25 lb twin tub with 250W wash motor and 140W spinner
products.description:
INTERGREAT is one of the few listings here that states motor power: 250 watts for washing and 140 watts for spinning, with a 1300 RPM spin. Separate knobs control wash and spin time, and two wash choices, Gentle and Normal, cover the basic fabric needs. Wash and spin can run at the same time.

Published wattage is useful because it tells you the machine is not a toy, but wattage does not tell you wash quality by itself. The 25 lb rating is a total of both tubs, so the wash tub holds less than that figure suggests.

For ownership, the listing itself reminds you to remove the filter and clear lint, which is a good habit. Keep clothes loose in the wash tub, balance the spin basket and let the unit drain and dry completely between loads. Wattage figures describe the motor, not the washing result, so judge the machine by how clean a normal load looks after one cycle, and lengthen the wash timer rather than overloading the tub. The separate knobs make it easy to run a long wash and a short spin for delicate items.
products.bestFor: Buyers who want published motor power and simple knobs.
pros: Motor power stated at 250W wash and 140W spin

products.name: Giantex 20 lb portable twin tub washer and spinner
products.description:
Giantex lists a 20 lb total, split into a 12 lb rated wash tub and a smaller spinner. The 15 minute wash timer and 5 minute spin timer make it a classic twin tub, and the listing instructs you to run a rinse cycle for the wash tub before spinning.

The key detail is the 12 lb wash rating. It is a smaller real wash capacity than the Auertech's 18 lb, so the 20 lb headline overstates what you can wash in one go. It does keep the price tier modest.

For ownership, plan the rinse as a deliberate step and refill the wash tub with clean water for it. Clear the lint filter each time and keep a towel nearby for the drip at the drain hose. As the spin tub is smaller than the wash tub, wring out very wet items by hand first, and load the spinner symmetrically with towels opposite each other so the basket stays steady. Wipe the inside after the last load of the week and leave both lids open.
products.bestFor: Budget households that want a recognizable brand and modest capacity.
pros: Simple and proven twin tub design
12 lb wash rating suits small households
cons: Real wash capacity is smaller than the headline

products.name: JUJOJB 20L folding mini washer and spin-dryer
products.description:
The JUJOJB is a different kind of machine: a foldable 20 liter bucket washer with a spin basket, three modes and a blue-light feature that the listing highlights. It folds flat for storage, which makes it a travel and dorm item more than a household appliance.

The tradeoff is scale. Twenty liters is a few garments, so it suits underwear, socks and baby clothes rather than family laundry. Against the Auertech it holds a small fraction as much.

For ownership, rinse the bucket after each use, dry the folds and store it open if you can. Keep the power adapter away from water and treat the lid and seals gently, since folding designs wear at the creases.
products.bestFor: Dorm rooms and travelers who wash small items and want to store the machine flat.

products.name: ROVSUN 25 lb fully automatic portable washer 2.3 cu ft
products.description:
The ROVSUN is the one machine here that does the whole job unattended. Wash, rinse and spin happen in a single stainless steel drum, and ten wash modes with five water levels let you scale the fill to the load. The listing describes a diamond-textured drum meant to reduce wear on fabrics.

It sits at the top of this cap, so it costs noticeably more than the twin tubs, and it is also the bulkiest. Compared with the Auertech it removes every manual step but spins more gently, so clothes come out damper and spend longer on a rack.

For ownership, the machine needs a faucet connection and a drain each time you run it. Leave the lid open between loads, wipe the rim and rinse the inlet screens when flow drops, because a portable that stays damp is the usual source of musty odor.
products.bestFor: Anyone who wants wash, rinse and spin without hand transfer and can stretch to the top of the cap.
pros: Wash, rinse and spin run in one drum
25 lb drum takes bedding and towels
Ten modes and five water levels
cons: Highest price of the machines here
Needs a faucet and a drain at each use

buyingCriteria.explanation: Under this cap most choices are twin tubs and folding bucket washers, with a single fully automatic portable, the ROVSUN, squeezed in at the top. A twin tub saves money by making you the transfer mechanism between wash and spin. Decide whether that labor is acceptable before you look at prices, because pretending a twin tub is hands-free leads to disappointment, and a fully automatic machine at the cap costs noticeably more than the cheapest tub on the list.

A 28 lb rating like the Auertech's includes the spin basket, and the wash tub is 18 lb. The Giantex lists 20 lb total with a 12 lb wash tub. Always find the wash tub number, because that is what limits one load.

A 1300 rpm spin, listed by the Auertech, SUPER DEAL and INTERGREAT, pulls out a lot of water. Damp-dry clothes dry far sooner on a rack. A weak spin turns a cheap machine into a long hang-drying chore.
A built-in drain pump, as on the Auertech, lets you aim water into a high sink. Gravity-drain machines need the hose to end below the tub. Check where your drain is before you order.
Lightweight plastic cabinets walk when the spin tub is unbalanced. Spread clothes evenly, and place a rubber mat under the feet. Stability matters more than any cycle feature at this price.
Twin tubs rely on a lint filter that fills quickly. The INTERGREAT listing itself reminds you to clear it. A clogged filter leaves lint on dark clothes and slows draining.

specDecoder.meaning: Two separate tubs, one for washing and one for spinning. You move clothes between them by hand.
specDecoder.watchFor: The Auertech, SUPER DEAL, INTERGREAT and Giantex are twin tubs.

specDecoder.meaning: How many pounds the wash tub is rated for. It limits one load.
specDecoder.watchFor: The Auertech lists 18 lb and the Giantex 12 lb within larger totals.

specDecoder.meaning: How fast the spin basket turns. Higher speeds extract more water.
The power of the wash motor. It indicates how hard the agitator can work.
A knob that sets how many minutes the wash runs. Short maximums mean resetting for heavy soil.
specDecoder.watchFor: The SUPER DEAL and Giantex stop at 15 minutes.

howWeEvaluated.title: Real wash capacity
howWeEvaluated.description: We separated wash tub numbers from total ratings. The Auertech's 18 lb led, and the Giantex's 12 lb sits lower.

howWeEvaluated.title: Spin extraction
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared stated spin speeds. Three machines list 1300 rpm, which earned top marks. The JUJOJB's spin basket scored lower as a mini unit.

howWeEvaluated.title: Motor transparency
howWeEvaluated.description: We rewarded listings that publish motor wattage, as the INTERGREAT does. Silent listings got neutral scores.

howWeEvaluated.title: Drain flexibility
howWeEvaluated.description: We checked for drain pumps. The Auertech's pump earned credit.

howWeEvaluated.title: Fit for the cap
howWeEvaluated.description: We kept only items with live prices at or under the cap and ranked them by usable work per effort.

cards.label: Twin tub
cards.text: The Auertech, SUPER DEAL, INTERGREAT and Giantex handle real loads and spin hard. They are cheap to run but need hand transfer.

cards.label: Folding bucket
cards.text: The JUJOJB folds away and suits small garments. It cannot replace a household washer.

howToChoose.note: Choose a twin tub for laundry volume, the bucket for travel and tiny items.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A small footprint, light weight and a drain you can reach. Noise and vibration matter to neighbors.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The SUPER DEAL and JUJOJB tuck away. The Auertech's pump helps if the drain is awkward.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want a one-drum fully automatic washer, which here means the ROVSUN at the top of the cap. Beyond this cap, several fully automatic portables open up, and the Auertech remains the best twin tub if you stay under it.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You wash a few items at a time. The SUPER DEAL or JUJOJB covers the need.

maintenance.why: Twin tubs shed a lot of lint. A clogged filter slows draining and soils dark clothes.
Soap film and damp plastic cause odor. Leave lids open between uses.
Vibration loosens hose clamps. A small drip from the drain hose becomes a puddle.
The switch stops the motor when you lift the lid. Test it to be sure it works.
An unbalanced spin basket shakes the cabinet. Even loading protects the motor.

faq.q: Can I get a fully automatic washer under $300?
faq.a: Yes, but only just. The ROVSUN 25 lb sits at the top of this cap and is the one fully automatic machine here, while twin tubs and a folding bucket fill the rest of the list. Check its live price before you buy, since a small move can push it over the line. If you want more fully automatic choices, a higher cap opens up several.

faq.q: How much laundry does a twin tub really handle?
faq.a: Use the wash tub rating, not the total. The Auertech washes about 18 lb at a time and the Giantex 12 lb. A week of laundry for two usually takes two or three loads.
They clean small to medium loads well because the agitator is simple and effective. Pre-treat stains and avoid overloading. The short wash timers may need two runs for heavy soil.

faq.q: Is a drain pump worth it?
faq.a: If your drain is higher than the machine, yes. The Auertech's pump moves water upward. Otherwise a gravity hose is fine.

faq.q: Will a twin tub wake my neighbors?
faq.a: A balanced spin is moderate in noise, but an unbalanced load can bang the cabinet. Use a rubber mat and distribute clothes evenly. Avoid late-night spins on a thin floor.

faq.q: How do the prices stay under the cap?
faq.a: The cap reflects listing prices at the time of the last update, and listings change. Check the live price before buying. If one moves over the cap, the next on the list is a close alternative.
